latest.title: Maslov Indicies In Symplectic Geometry Revisited
latest.abstract: Thirty years ago in ``On the Maslov Index'' the present authors with their late collaborator Prof. Ronnie Lee of Yale University presented an axiomatization of the Maslov index, an integer-valued invariant of continuous, piecewise smooth paths of pairs of Lagrangians. Four distinct methods of definition of such Maslov indicies were given; each satisfying the axioms. Here two more are offered and comparisons are made to the recent work of Her and Zhong defining an invariant of a path of symplectic matrices motivated by earlier work of Lidskii and Gelfand, Salomon and Zehnder.
latest.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
latest.workSummary: 在既有 Maslov 指标公理化框架中补充两种定义，并与由辛矩阵路径得到的近期指标构造进行比较。
latest.breakthrough: 扩展了同一公理体系下的可选实现，并澄清经典 Maslov 指标与近期矩阵路径不变量之间的关系。
latest.limitations: 工作偏基础整理和等价性比较，摘要未显示对新的几何应用或尖锐估计有直接推进。
latest.priorityReason: 是可靠的辛几何基础工具，但相对于曲率、几何流和度量几何主线，影响范围较专门。
